method: Static reverse engineering with rizin; samples were not executed. ML and external labels were not used as proof. Supplied external report pages were inaccessible.

samples.identification: Mach-O x86-64 XOR TCP stage downloader
evidence: main 0x100003b06 exits if /tmp/log_de.log exists; 0x100003c1a retries an outbound TCP connection with 10-second sleeps.
0x100003d54 receives up to 4096 bytes, 0x100003d9c XORs each byte with 0x99, and 0x100003dd7 writes the buffer to /tmp/.X1-unix (fallback ./.w). The file is chmod 0700.

0x100003e55 forks: the child attempts to remove the downloaded file, while the parent calls execvp on that path with [kworker/0:2] as argv[0]. This is a deletion/execution race, not guaranteed successful cleanup.
samples.trait_changes: None: the existing downloader and process-name masquerade hostile traits are supported.

samples.identification: KernelYK/NtHook rootkit installer carrying Gh0st-derived safemon.dll
evidence: main 0x401c4d through 0x401cc5 enumerates guest-agent process names and takes an alternate branch when a match is found; it also probes VMware Tools files.

CRT initializer code 0x4090b0 and 0x4090d0 resolves NetUserAdd and NetLocalGroupAddMembers through LoadLibraryW/GetProcAddress into global slots. Function 0x401350 calls those slots to create a fixed-credential user and add it to Administrators, deleting the account on group-add failure.
Installer enables SeLoadDriverPrivilege, creates driver registry configuration, loads NtHook and invokes rundll32 on safemon.dll hook2.

Embedded driver at file offset 0xba50: syscall-target dispatch at VA 0x13d7e selects interceptors; directory filtering at 0x1334a removes selected linked result records using buffer compaction at 0x1340b. Disk-write routine 0x12f00 installs embedded boot code; that code saves/replaces INT 13h and patches loaded code with a relocated far call.

Embedded DLL at file offset 0x147d8: 0x1000e354 polls virtual keys, tests the pressed bit, handles modifiers/backspace/Enter, and sends accumulated text to 0x1000e050. This recorder constructs ourlog.dat on the stack, XORs bytes with 0x62 at 0x1000e130, and passes that output to its resolved WriteFile pointer.

The same DLL resolves GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT) at 0x10010a5d, locks that handle and copies its text into a tagged record. hook2 enables debugging privilege and calls the implant setup path. Manager RTTI corroborates Gh0st lineage; it is not the basis for the behavioral verdict.
samples.trait_changes: Add notable code-bound account/group API-resolution detections and a neutral provisioning-surface composite; clarify existing symbol-reference descriptions. Each resolver binds the API-name pointer, LoadLibrary import, GetProcAddress import and global result store. No account creation, persistence or escalation is inferred from these neutral detections alone.

evidence: Entry CRT calls 0x401cb0. Configured mode 3 calls 0x401900, which constructs a GUID-named executable, registers an HKLM Active Setup StubPath at 0x401a4b, copies/patches its own image using CRT I/O and launches the copy.

The alternate service-DLL branch calls 0x401260 to replace LanmanServer Parameters ServiceDLL with a System32 DLL path. 0x402460 implements resource ID 101 extraction and writing. Its .rsrc is effectively erased, so a usable dropped DLL is not established.
0x401150 creates a selected host process, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path, resolves LoadLibraryA, and passes that address and remote path to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
0x401390 builds a COMSPEC /c del command from its own short pathname and launches it with CreateProcessA. The active mode calls this cleanup after its copy path.

The custom .htext contains repeated instruction/filler bytes and a damaged branch. The percent-decoded GUID-format text is a scanner interpretation of printf placeholders; no runtime URL decoder is established. No ransomware or worm behavior was found.
samples.trait_changes: None: existing hostile findings explicitly describe surviving injector, persistence and self-delete code, without claiming payload viability.

controls.expectation: All pass; names without resolver code, wrong pointer/call and thunks outside .text do not match. Neutral admin-utility resolution produces no suspicious or hostile findings.

validation_refinement: The initial name-only matcher fired on inert Go binaries during make validate. It was replaced with linked native resolver-code evidence, rather than a Go/package exception or severity demotion.
